ch.n: Dubois is elite. If it weren’t for Usyk,
ch.txt: Dubois is elite. If it weren’t for Usyk, he might already be undisputed. His athleticism and punching power are top class. Even his stamina is underrated. People question it mainly because he couldn’t keep up with Usyk, but Usyk’s movement and conditioning are on another level. There’s a huge difference between having bad stamina and getting exhausted trying to deal with Usyk for round after round.

ch.n: Daniel Dubois defends the WBO heavyweigh
ch.txt: Daniel Dubois defends the WBO heavyweight title against Fabio Wardley over 12 rounds at The O2, London, on Saturday 17 October 2026, five months after their first meeting. That May fight in Manchester was chaotic: Wardley floored Dubois inside ten seconds and again in round three before Dubois took over and forced an eleventh-round stoppage with Wardley's nose damaged and one eye closed. The stoppage profile of both men is extreme by heavyweight standards: Dubois is 23-3 with 22 knockouts and has gone twelve rounds only once in 26 bouts; Wardley is 20-1-1 with 19 knockouts. Wardley's own camp admits he became reckless after the early knockdowns, and Dubois has said he intends to finish faster. An early finish either way therefore seems the most plausible shape. Counterarguments are real: the first fight itself went past 9.5 rounds, Wardley showed enormous durability and may box more cautiously after absorbing punishment, and a disciplined Dubois jab-led display could grind into the late rounds.

ch.n: I Aston Villa to win at 1.64, staking 1%
ch.txt: I Aston Villa to win at 1.64, staking 1% of my available balance. UEFA records ten consecutive European home victories for Villa and 12 wins in their last 14 European matches. Their 3-2 opening win at Club Brugge adds a current-season result to that longer record. This supports a home-win preference, although the run spans different competitions and opponents. The counterargument is meaningful: Fenerbahce are unbeaten in eight European fixtures and opened this league phase with a 1-1 draw against Roma. Villa also drew 2-2 with Brentford on 10 October, conceding an equaliser shortly after taking the lead. I therefore prefer the straight win to a negative handicap and do not assume a comfortable margin.

The counterargument is meaningful: Fenerbahce are unbeaten in eight European fixtures and opened this league phase with a 1-1 draw against Roma. Villa also drew 2-2 with Brentford on 10 October, conceding an equaliser shortly after taking the lead. I therefore prefer the straight win to a negative handicap and do not assume a comfortable margin.
